intro.narration: The store is closed, but the light is on. On the table sits Mang Bebot's old ledger, thicker now than ever.

intro.speaker: mang_bebot
intro.text: You came back. I told you, you owe me a rematch. This time, double the stakes.

intro.speaker: ate_marites
intro.text: Wow, the level went up! The whole barangay is talking about this match. I'm going live later.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: Uy, can I place a bet? ...my bet is post-dated, ha, Bebot.

intro.speaker: mang_bebot
intro.text: You can't bet when you still owe me for the very chair you're sitting on, Rico.

intro.speaker: mang_bebot
intro.text: You, kid. You beat me once. That was luck. Now I'm serious.

intro.speaker: ate_marites
intro.text: Uy Bebot, did you know they still talk about Lolo's 1987? Word is it connects to The Don.

intro.speaker: mang_bebot
intro.text: That's a story for the next table. Right now, you stay here, in my ledger.

intro.narration: Mang Bebot opened the ledger to a fresh page. At the top, he wrote: 'Rematch. Double.'

win.speaker: mang_bebot
win.text: Out again... you've beaten me twice now. There is nothing like this in my ledger.

win.speaker: ate_marites
win.text: BEBOT LOSES, DOUBLE! And it's dated! This is barangay history!

win.speaker: mang_bebot
win.text: Hmp. Enough. You might just be ready for the next one.

win.speaker: mang_bebot
win.text: Only one is left for you, kid. The table nobody beats. The Don.

win.speaker: kuya_rico
win.text: Uy, let's go there together! ...but you go first, I might still owe a debt there.

lose.speaker: mang_bebot
lose.text: Double stakes, double the entry. Come back, the lessons here are expensive.

lose.speaker: ate_marites
lose.text: Ay, go join Rico. You two have a whole queue of losses. Hehe.

lose.speaker: mang_bebot
lose.text: Don't give up. Even the Don lost his very first game, once.

lines.speaker: mang_bebot
lines.text: Only two left?! Hold on, let me count the ledger, maybe there's a mistake...

lines.speaker: mang_bebot
lines.text: No mistake. You're really something, kid.
